title: Ignore wildcard identity namespace when building OpenFeature evaluation context
answers: Why are feature flag evaluations rejected with a namespace mismatch when using a cluster-wide service token?
How does ContextHandler resolve the namespace for the OpenFeature evaluation context?
Why does a wildcard '*' identity namespace break OpenFeature flag evaluation?
body:
Symptom: Feature flag evaluation requests fail with a namespace mismatch error when callers authenticate using wildcard identity namespaces such as cluster-wide service tokens.
Root cause: pkg/services/contexthandler/contexthandler.go:ContextHandler.setRequestContext set the OpenFeature evaluation context namespace directly from the caller identity without filtering out wildcard '*' or empty strings, overriding instance-level scoping.
Fix pattern: Check that caller identity namespace is non-empty and not '*' before adopting it, otherwise fall back to stack configuration ('stacks-' + StackID) or 'default' to ensure evaluation context remains concrete.
Constraints: Applies when constructing OpenFeature evaluation contexts from incoming authentication identities; concrete non-wildcard caller namespaces must still take precedence over instance stack ID.
applies: Request context initialization when configuring OpenFeature evaluation context from caller identity.
